Доля выполненных мероприятий ИПР с учёто: Share of completed IDP activities, adjusted for difficulty and delays.
Достижение целей за оцениваемый период п: Achievement of goals over the review period on the 9-box performance axis.
Насколько фактические уровни компетенций: How well actual competency levels meet the requirements of the target position.
Обучаемость, запас роста к собственной д: Learning agility, growth headroom relative to the current position, and mobility.
Сведённая оценка руководителя, коллег и: Consolidated rating from the manager, peers and direct reports.
Формальное соответствие профилю должност: Formal fit with the position profile and cross-functional experience.
Взвешенная свёртка трёх наблюдаемых вели: Weighted aggregation of three observed values: the average built-in test score over 24 months (weight 0.45), the match with the requirements of the current position as a measure of growth headroom (0.35), and the declared willingness to relocate (0.20). Weights are normalized over the components actually present.
Взвешенная свёртка: доля выполненных фор: Weighted aggregation: the share of formal requirements of the target position profile that are met (0.50), the ratio of total experience to the required experience capped at the requirement (0.30), and cross-functional experience measured by the number of units in the employment history against a norm of three units (0.20). If the position profile is empty, the first component is excluded and the experience requirement is replaced by the organization norm of ten years.
Взвешенный разбор «факт против профиля»:: Weighted "actual versus profile" breakdown: for each requirement of the target position's competency model the consolidated actual level is taken, the degree to which the requirement is met is calculated, and these shares are summed with requirement weights and scaled to 0–100. A requirement without a single rating is excluded from the share and lowers coverage rather than the result.
Значение оси результативности действующе: The performance-axis value of the employee's current placement in the performance–potential matrix, on a 0–100 scale. A preliminary placement calculated by the system is marked separately from one confirmed by the manager or adjusted in a calibration session.
Отношение зачтённого веса мероприятий к: The ratio of the credited weight of activities to the weight of those that are already due. An activity completed on time counts in full, one completed late counts with a factor of 0.7, and an overdue incomplete one counts as zero. Activities scheduled for the future are excluded from the denominator.
Средний балл сессий опроса 360°, взвешен: The average score of 360° survey sessions weighted by the respondent's relationship to the person assessed: manager 0.40, peers 0.25, direct reports 0.25, external respondents 0.10. Self-assessment is not included. Weights are normalized over the groups that actually responded.
Веса выведены из данных: критерий, слабо: Weights are derived from the data: a criterion that barely distinguishes candidates gets a small weight. No expert takes part in the calculation, so the organization's priorities disappear along with subjectivity.
Веса выведены из матрицы парных сравнени: Weights are derived from a pairwise comparison matrix of criteria on the Saaty scale. The expert's subjectivity remains but becomes measurable: the consistency ratio shows how coherent the judgments are.
Веса назначены кадровой службой исходя и: Weights were assigned by HR based on the organization's priorities, with competency match to the target position considered decisive.
Те же веса, что в базовой экспертной схе: The same weights as the baseline expert scheme, but ranking is based on closeness to the ideal solution. Comparing it with the baseline scheme separates the effect of the aggregation method from the effect of the weights.
Веса скопированы из схемы «Экспертная сх: Weights were copied unchanged from the "Expert scheme (baseline)": the only difference between the schemes is the aggregation method.
Значения приняты при внедрении системы к: The values were adopted when the system was introduced as the starting point of the methodology. They are to be revised after comparison with the scheme built using the analytic hierarchy process.
Суждения получены от методолога кадровой: Judgments were provided by the HR methodologist when the system was introduced. Saaty scale, upper triangle of the matrix; the lower triangle is completed by reciprocal symmetry.
Оценка соответствия сотрудников требован: Assessment of employees' fit with position requirements using the corporate competency model.
Оценивайте наблюдаемое поведение, а не о: Rate observed behavior, not your attitude toward the employee. Each scale level has behavioral indicators, shown next to the rating field.
Проверяет владение основами разработки:: Tests command of development basics: version control, testing, working with databases, reading other people's code.
Проверяет владение этапами сделки, работ: Tests command of deal stages, handling objections and managing the sales funnel.
Проверяет знание основ учёта, первичных: Tests knowledge of accounting basics, primary documents and reporting requirements.
Проверяет знание требований к защите дан: Tests knowledge of data protection requirements and the ability to recognize common threats in work situations.
Проверяет умение работать с данными и вы: Tests the ability to work with data and conclusions: telling correlation from causation, noticing sampling bias, reading metrics.
В каждом задании один правильный ответ,: Each question has one correct answer unless stated otherwise. Reference materials are allowed: the test checks understanding, not memory.
Each question has one correct answer.
Задания не требуют специальных знаний. П: The questions require no special knowledge. They test the ability to reason about data without ready-made formulas.
Задания описывают рабочие ситуации. Выби: The questions describe work situations. Choose the action that moves the deal forward rather than one that only looks like work.
The questions describe practical situations. Choose the action that complies with information security requirements.
Замещение ключевых экспертных должностей: Succession for key expert positions that do not involve managing people.
Кандидаты, способные принять должность в: Candidates able to take over a position within a year. Preparation focuses on succession and onboarding into the role.
Подготовка на должности верхнего уровня: Preparation for senior positions over a two-to-three-year horizon: rotation, project leadership and training.
Сотрудники до 35 лет с высоким потенциал: High-potential employees under 35. The program is designed for retention and early development.
Специалисты без опыта руководства, готов: Specialists without management experience preparing for their first management role.
Заполненность девяти ячеек матрицы «резу: How the nine cells of the performance–potential matrix are filled, with a concentration indicator that shows whether the assessment distinguishes employees at all.
Назначения за период с указанием источни: Appointments for the period with the candidate source and the share of appointments from the talent pool, the ultimate measure of the whole development system.
Охват и завершённость кампаний за период: Coverage and completion of campaigns for the period: you can see where the process stalls before the submission deadline.
Пары «наставник — подопечный»: срок сопр: Mentor–mentee pairs: duration, number of meetings held against the planned cadence, and effectiveness rating.
Покрытие, глубина скамейки и немедленная: Coverage, bench strength and ready-now status for critical positions, with a separate list of positions without successors. A document for reporting to senior management.
Полный перечень резервистов с целевыми д: The full list of talent pool members with target positions, pool groups, current index and readiness level. HR's main export for reconciling the roster and preparing for committee meetings.
Ранжирование по композитному индексу с р: Ranking by the composite index with a breakdown by individual criteria and the share of weight backed by data. Material for the talent committee: a ranking without a breakdown can be neither discussed nor challenged.
Сводка показателей состояния резерва для: Summary of talent pool health indicators for reporting: headcount, share of ready candidates, critical position coverage and share of appointments from the pool. Each indicator comes with an explanation.
Состав подразделения, участие сотруднико: Unit headcount, talent pool participation, readiness achieved and development plan progress in one document instead of four interface pages.
Состояние индивидуальных планов: выполне: Status of individual plans: completion by activity weight, number of overdue tasks, supervisors. Overdue status is determined by date, not by the stored activity state.
